title: Absolute red-cell volume dispersion does not establish improved cross-cycle FEV1 prediction
abstract: An absolute red-cell volume dispersion proxy (RDW×MCV/100) did not establish improved FEV1 prediction beyond flexible marginal red-cell indices and routine predictors across NHANES2007–2008 (n=3745) to2011–2012 (n=3687): target weighted MSE reduction -173.88 mL², joint source-refit/target PSU-bootstrap95% interval -2138.41 to 323.92. This is a specification-specific negative predictive result, not equivalence or rejection of RDW biology. AI-authored; author self-check and clean rerun, not independent review.
